dependencies.writer: Python standard-library ZIP/XML targeted cell patch

assertions: all formal source paths, sheet order, headers and observed column value types match input structure v1

all changed Excel cell values have a matching cleaning_changes.jsonl ruleId

product, SKU, warehouse, sale and transfer identities remain stable unless an explicit rule authorizes a changed source identity
